dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Not a single soul in sight on this dark and silent night... ♪
Yet the shadows sneak ever closer to you... ♪
<$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you flee or do you fight? Do you chase after the light? ♪
As you pause for thought, the voices cry out...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Nem uma única alma à vista nesta noite escura e silenciosa...
No entanto, as sombras estão cada vez mais perto de ti...
<$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Você foge ou luta? Você persegue a luz?
Enquanto você pára para pensar, as vozes gritam...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$textsize(2)>BOO!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$textsize(2)>Boo!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh dear... Did I frighten you, little one?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Meu Deus, assustei-te, pequenino?

dialogues.en: <$motion(2,806)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(2,2)>You...
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,806)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(2,2)>Você...

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,6)><$kfacial(2)><$textsize(2)>YOU’RE AMAZING!!!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,6)><$kfacial(2)><$textsize(2)>Você é incrível!!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)>...Come again?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)>Como é que é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)><$kfacial(2)>You’re SOOO good at singing, <$cdef(27)><$cname(510)>! That’s so great!
I wanna be just like you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)><$kfacial(2)>Você é SOOO bom em cantar, <$cdef(27)><$cname(510)>Isso é tão bom!
Quero ser como tu!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,3)>I...see. So you weren’t frightened at all...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,7)>No, surely that can’t be it. Let’s try this one more time.
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,800)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>In a place that no one knows, secret to both friend and foe... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,59)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu... ver. Então você não estava assustado em tudo...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,7)>Não, certamente que não pode ser isso. Vamos tentar isso mais uma vez.
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,800)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Num lugar que ninguém sabe, secreto para amigos e inimigos...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Nobody will help, if you can’t make it through! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Ninguém vai ajudar, se você não conseguir passar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,58)>...What’s this? Why are you singing with me?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,58)>Por que você está cantando comigo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,16)>Huh? <$voicel(2,3)>Aren’t you gonna keep singing? It’s your turn next,
<$cdef(27)><$cname(510)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,16)>Huh? <$voicel(2,3)>Você não vai continuar cantando? É a sua vez em seguida,
<$cdef(27)><$cname(510)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)>O-oh, is it? Very well...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>See a shadow on the wall as you tiptoe down the hall... ♪
If you turn around, my dear, then...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)>Muito bem...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Vêem uma sombra na parede enquanto descem os pés pelo corredor...
Se te virares, minha querida, então...

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,804)><$motion(2,804)><$textsize(2)>I’ll curse you!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,804)><$motion(2,804)><$textsize(2)>Vou amaldiçoá-lo!</textsize>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Phew! What a fun duet! <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,57)>Let’s sing together again
sometime!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Que dueto divertido! <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,57)>Vamos cantar juntos novamente
Um dia destes!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)>That didn’t scare you one bit, did it...?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)>Isso não o assustou nem um pouco, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Can you believe it?
<$cdef(27)><$cname(313)><$cdef(27)>
just
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,41)>came
up
and
tried
to bite
my apple
out of
nowhere!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Dá para acreditar?
<$cdef(27)><$cname(313)><$cdef(27)>
Apenas...
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,41)>veio
para cima
e
tentou
para morder
minha maçã
fora de
Em lado nenhum!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,15)>Oh, sorry. My bad.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,58)>It just looked so delicious, I couldn’t help myself.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,15)>Desculpa, foi mal.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,58)>Parecia tão delicioso, que eu não conseguia evitar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Looked delicious, huh... <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>I’m impressed you could tell! <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,64)>By
the way, what made you think my apple looks delicious?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Parecia delicioso, não é? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Estou impressionado que você possa ver! <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,64)>Por
O que te fez pensar que a minha maçã está deliciosa?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,14)><$comeff(2,14)>In terms of shine, size, and ripeness...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>it’s practically
perfect in every way.
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>It’s gotta be the most beautiful apple out there.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,14)><$comeff(2,14)>Em termos de brilho, tamanho e maturidade...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>é praticamente
perfeito em todos os sentidos.
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>Tem que ser a maçã mais bonita lá fora.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,62)>Hehehe... But you can’t just take a bite, OK?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,62)>Hehehe... Mas você não pode apenas dar uma mordida, OK?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,38)>Really, though, <$cdef(27)><$cname(511)>, I’ve never seen such a beautiful
apple before. I feel like I could gaze at it forever.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,57)>I bet it tastes as good as it looks...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,38)>A sério, no entanto, <$cdef(27)><$cname(511)>, Eu nunca vi uma tão bela
Sinto como se pudesse olhar para ela para sempre.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,57)>Aposto que sabe tão bem quanto parece...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Hehehe... It does taste wonderful... I’d love for you to
experience how sweet it—
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,13)>Hey, wait a minute! <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,58)>You can flatter me, but you’re still not
getting a bite!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Hehehe... É um sabor maravilhoso... Eu adoraria que você
experimentar o quão doce é—
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,13)>Ei, espere um minuto! <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,58)>Você pode me bajular, mas você ainda não é
Vou dar uma mordidela!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,41)>Ugh, so close...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,41)>Tão perto...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,65)>Apples always fall to the ground on their own...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,65)>Maçãs caem sempre no chão por conta própria...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Yep, that’s true.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, isso é verdade.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Why do you suppose that is?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,6)>Porque é que achas que é isso?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,48)><$voicel(1,6)>Yooo... I’ve never really thought about it, but that IS kinda
weird, huh?
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Nobody’s pullin’ on ’em or anything, so why do they all
fall down to the ground?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,48)><$voicel(1,6)>Yooo... Eu nunca realmente pensei sobre isso, mas isso é meio
Estranho, não é?
<$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Ninguém está puxando 'em ou qualquer coisa, então por que eles todos
Cair no chão?

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Precisely... Even though no one is pulling them...
<$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Eureka! I’ve deduced the answer!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Precisamente... mesmo que ninguém os esteja a puxar...
<$voicel(2,2)>... ... ...
<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Eureka! Eu deduzi a resposta!

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! You have?! You gotta tell me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>tem de me dizer!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,48)><$voicel(2,3)>As we’ve established, there is no reason for the apples to
move if no one is pulling them.
<$voicel(2,2)>Which can only mean...<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>a Pokémon hiding underground is
pulling them down—using psychic power!
<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,6)>They must have an insatiable craving for apples...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,48)><$voicel(2,3)>Como estabelecemos, não há razão para as maçãs
Mexe-te se ninguém os estiver a puxar.
<$voicel(2,2)>O que só pode significar...<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Um Pokémon escondido no subsolo é
puxando-os para baixo – usando o poder psíquico!
<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,6)>Devem ter um desejo insaciável de maçãs...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,2)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>That’s...
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s AMAZING! Wow, <$cdef(27)><$cname(29)>! You’re super smart!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>This’s gotta be the discovery of the century!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,2)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>Isso é...
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso é incrível! Uau, <$cdef(27)><$cname(29)>Você é super inteligente!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Esta tem de ser a descoberta do século!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Hahaha, you flatter me.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Hahaha, tu lisonjeias-me.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m not just tryin’ to flatter you! I’m bein’ serious! But...
There’s really a Pokémon out there who wants apples so
bad that they pull ’em off trees, huh?
<$emotion(1,48)><$voicel(1,6)>Wow... That’s almost a scary level of apple obsession, yo.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,7)>Não estou apenas tentando elogiar você! Estou falando sério! Mas...
Há realmente um Pokémon lá fora que quer maçãs assim
É mau que os arranquem das árvores, não é?
<$emotion(1,48)><$voicel(1,6)>Uau... Isso é quase um nível assustador de obsessão por maçãs, yo.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Heh heh, indeed. If I ever meet that Pokémon, I’ll have to
give them a stern talking-to.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Heh heh, de fato. Se eu encontrar aquele Pokémon, eu terei que
Dá-lhes uma conversa séria.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Phew! It’s been fun playing with you today. Let’s all do this
again sometime.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Ufa! Tem sido divertido jogar com você hoje. Vamos todos fazer isso
outra vez.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,3)>“All”? Uh, it’s just you and me here, right?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,3)>“Tudo”? Uh, é só você e eu aqui, certo?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,7)>Hey now, don’t forget about me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,7)>Hey agora, não se esqueça de mim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>I’m...not? Like I said, you and me are the only ones here.
Unless there’s someone else?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu... não? Como eu disse, você e eu somos os únicos aqui.
A menos que haja outra pessoa?

dialogues.en:
... ... ...
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,7)>OH! Maybe I didn’t explain yet.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>See, there’s actually two of us in this apple. This head
sticking out? That’s me.
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,7)>OH! Talvez eu ainda não tenha explicado.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Veja, há realmente dois de nós nesta maçã.
que sou eu.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,10)>And I’m the one whose tail you see sticking out!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,10)>E eu sou o único cuja cauda você vê que se destaca!

dialogues.en:
Uh... <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>What are you talking about?! No matter how you
look at it, there’s only one you!
dialogues.pt_br:
Uh... <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>De que está a falar?
Olhe para ele, há apenas um você!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Yeah, I guess it might seem that way, since you can’t see
inside here...
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,7)>But the two of us live in this apple together.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,3)>Sim, eu acho que pode parecer que, uma vez que você não pode ver
Aqui dentro...
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas nós os dois vivemos juntos nesta maçã.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,7)>Yup! We’re a two-for-one deal!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,14)><$voicetonevar(1,7)>Sim! Somos um negócio de dois por um!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,2)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>Ohhh, I get it now.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>Ohhh, eu entendo agora.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,8)>Great, glad you understand.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,8)>Óptimo, ainda bem que compreendes.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah. You’ve got an imaginary friend!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim. Você tem um amigo imaginário!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,9)><$voicetonevar(1,9)>Not...exactly.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,9)><$voicetonevar(1,9)>Não exactamente.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,3)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(515)>, is it true you’re like us?<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)> I mean, that
you’ve got a bunch of you all livin’ together?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,3)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(515)>, É verdade que você é como nós?<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)> Quero dizer, isso...
você tem um monte de você todos vivendo juntos?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Sure do! <wait(1.5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Lots of us are all hangin’ out in this here apple!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Claro que sim! <wait(1.5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Muitos de nós estamos todos pendurados’ nesta maçã aqui!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,53)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, no way! Pretty impressive you can all live in there
without fightin’ constantly.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,53)><$voicel(2,7)>É impressionante que todos possam viver lá.
sem lutar’ constantemente.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$voicel(1,3)>Oh, we have our fair share of fights!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$voicel(1,3)>Temos a nossa quota-parte de lutas!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,16)><$voicel(2,6)>For real?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,16)><$voicel(2,6)>A sério?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Seems like we’re always bickerin’ over who bumped into
who or who looked at who funny—that sort o’ thing.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,8)>Why, we once didn’t speak to each other fer three whole
days after arguin’ over what to eat fer dinner!
<$emotion(1,122)><$voicel(1,3)>We’re a li’l self-centered in our own way, y’know.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Parece que estamos sempre brigando’ sobre quem esbarrou
quem ou quem olhou para quem engraçado – esse tipo de coisa.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,8)>Ora, uma vez não nos falamos um com o outro fer três inteiro
dias após arguin’ sobre o que comer fer jantar!
<$emotion(1,122)><$voicel(1,3)>Nós somos um li'l egocêntrico em nossa própria maneira, você sabe.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Dang, that’s wild...
All of us get along super well, so <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>we’ve never had to deal
with stuff like that.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Caramba, isso é selvagem...
Todos nos damos muito bem, então... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>nós nunca tivemos que lidar
com coisas assim.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,8)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, we may squabble a lot, but we get along jus’ fine
when the situation demands it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,8)><$kfacial(1)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, podemos brigar muito, mas nos damos bem só
quando a situação o exige!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Reeeaaally? Not gonna lie, that’s kinda hard to believe...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Não vou mentir, é difícil de acreditar...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,644)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,9)>Believe it, pal!<wait(0.5)><$lookat(0,0,1)><$lookat(0,1,1)><$facial(0,13)><waitactor(0)>
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,644)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,9)>Acredita, amigo!<wait(0.5)><$lookat(0,0,1)><$lookat(0,1,1)><$facial(0,13)><waitactor(0)>

dialogues.en:
<$facial(0,1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Whoa! You’re all so in sync...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Guess everyone’s got their own way of livin’ as a group.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(0,1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Vocês estão todos em sincronia...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Acho que todos têm sua própria maneira de viver como um grupo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,4)>Yooo... You’re so gold and sparkly and BEAUTIFUL,
<$cdef(27)><$cname(268)>. <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>I’m kinda jealous, to be honest!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>You GOTTA tell me how I can get sparkly like you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,4)>Yooo... Você é tão ouro e brilhante e bonito,
<$cdef(27)><$cname(268)>. <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu sou meio ciumento, para ser honesto!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>tem de me dizer como posso ficar brilhante como tu!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,50)>Hehe... Thaaank you.
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,2)><$comeff(2,6)>But I don’t know how to be like me...
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,65)>I just kind of turned out this way.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,50)>Ele... o Thaaank.
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,2)><$comeff(2,6)>Mas eu não sei como ser como eu...
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,65)>Eu acabei por ser assim.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,51)>I guess that makes sense. Dang. Too bad...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,51)>Acho que faz sentido.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>There is ooone thing. <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,8)><$facial(2,4)>I’ve liked sparkly stuff since I was
really little...
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Maybe my love of sparkly stuff made me sparkly, too... <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,10)>
Kind of weeeiiird, huh?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Há uma coisa. <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,8)><$facial(2,4)>Eu gosto de coisas brilhantes desde que eu era
Muito pequeno...
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Talvez o meu amor por coisas brilhantes também me tenha feito brilhar... <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,10)>
Mais ou menos, huh?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>Whoa! Then maybe I can sparkle one day too, yo! <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>I LOVE
pretty stuff, y’know?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,27)>Então talvez eu também possa brilhar um dia, yo! <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>EU AMO
Coisas bonitas, sabe?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,37)>Hehe. Just like me... <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,3)>Yeahhh. Maybe you’ll get gold and
sparkly too one day...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>But I get the feeling you might become even prettier...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,37)>Assim como eu... <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,3)>Sim. Talvez você vai obter ouro e
Brilhante também um dia...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>Mas tenho a sensação de que pode ficar ainda mais bonita...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,62)>Seriously?! Hehe! Now you’ve got me all excited!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,62)>Sério?! Hehe! Agora você me deixou todo animado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>What’s this? <$cdef(27)><$cname(505)>, it seems your scales have lost
some luster.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>O que é isso? <$cdef(27)><$cname(505)>Parece que as suas escamas perderam.
Um pouco de brilho.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,64)>Have they? Where?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,64)>- Onde?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>Right over here. Why don’t I go ahead and polish them up
for you, hm?
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,814)>*brush* <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,814)>*shine*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>Bem aqui. Por que eu não vou em frente e poli-los
Para ti, hum?
<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,814)>* Escova * <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,814)>*Shine *

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Why thank you... <wait(1.2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Ahaha! That tickles.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Obrigado... <wait(1.2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Isso faz cócegas.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,52)>Oh dear, now I’ve spotted some dust on your face. Let me
get that for you...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)>*brush brush*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,52)>Oh querida, agora eu vi um pouco de pó em seu rosto. Deixe-me
Vou buscar-te isso...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)>Pincel de pincel

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,41)>Ah... Ah... I feel a sneeze coming on...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,41)>Sinto um espirro a aproximar-se...

dialogues.en:
And...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,63)>there. Phew, all finished!
<$emotion(2,65)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,31)>You know, now that those spots are clean, I can’t help but
notice other places that could use a touch-up...
dialogues.pt_br:
E...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,63)>Pronto, já está!
<$emotion(2,65)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,31)>Você sabe, agora que esses pontos estão limpos, Eu não posso ajudar, mas
notar outros lugares que poderiam usar um retoque-up...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,59)>What?! Surely you don’t intend to keep going!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,59)>O quê?! Certamente você não pretende continuar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>But of course! No sense leaving a job half done, hm?
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>If it’s worth cleaning, it’s worth cleaning properly.
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,38)>Now then, get ready for a thorough dusting!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Não faz sentido deixar um trabalho meio feito.
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>Se vale a pena limpar, vale a pena limpar corretamente.
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,38)>Agora, então, preparem-se para uma limpeza completa!

dialogues.en: <$facial(1,14)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,814)>*primp* <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,814)>*brush* <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,4)>*preen* <wait(2.2)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,4)>*wipe* <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,815)>*polish* <wait(2.2)><$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,4)>*shine*
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(1,14)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,814)>*Primp * <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,814)>* Escova * <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,4)>*Preen* <wait(2.2)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,4)>* Wipe * <wait(1.6)><$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,815)>*Plish * <wait(2.2)><$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,4)>*Shine *

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>There we go—now you’re sparkling clean. Perfect!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Lá vamos nós - agora você está brilhando limpo. Perfeito!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,51)>My goodness... Cleanliness takes quite a lot of effort.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,51)>Meu Deus, a limpeza requer muito esforço.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,51)>*sigh* Nothing here either...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,51)>Nada aqui também...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>What are you looking for, <$cdef(27)><$cname(509)></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>O que está à procura? <$cdef(27)><$cname(509)></color>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)><$cname(157)>! I was just looking for some spirits...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)>I’ve been collecting them for ages, but I can’t seem to find
any around here...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)><$cname(157)>Estava à procura de uns espíritos...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,65)>Eu tenho coletado-los por séculos, mas eu não consigo encontrar
Qualquer um por aqui...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, yes. Unfortunately, there’s not much that can be done
about that now, given there aren’t any humans around.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, sim. Infelizmente, não há muito que possa ser feito
sobre isso agora, dado que não há nenhum ser humano ao redor.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>That’s right...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,66)>I wonder what happened to them... Do you think they’re
completely gone?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>Isso mesmo...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,66)>Eu me pergunto o que aconteceu com eles... Você acha que eles são
Completamente desaparecido?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)>I expect they traveled to some faraway place, but surely
they’ll return in due time.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)>Espero que tenham viajado para algum lugar distante, mas certamente
Eles voltarão no tempo devido.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,16)>Oh... Why do you think that?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,16)>Porque achas isso?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,65)>Haven’t you noticed? Not a single human spirit is
lingering anywhere around here.
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Surely that means they found safety elsewhere.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,65)>Você não notou? Nenhum espírito humano é
Permanecendo em qualquer lugar aqui.
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Isso significa, sem dúvida, que encontraram segurança noutro lugar.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Right, that makes sense! I hope they come back soon...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Espero que voltem em breve.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Given all the incredible work <$cdef(27)> is
doing
to
restore
this
land,
I’m
certain
they will!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Dado todo o trabalho incrível <$cdef(27)> é
fazendo
para
restaurar
isto
terras,
Eu sou
certo
Eles vão!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>*sniff sniff* Whoooaaa... Something smells really good
around here.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>Cheira muito bem.
Por aqui.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>How curious—I was just thinking the same thing! Such a
scrumptious smell... I’m starting to feel quite peckish.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Quão curioso — eu estava pensando a mesma coisa!
cheiro delicioso... Estou começando a sentir bastante fome.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Yeahhh...
<$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>It smells like freshly baked bread. Amaaazing.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Sim...
<$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Cheira a pão recém-assado.

dialogues.en:
... ... ...<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)><$voicel(2,7)>
Hold on. That might be me, not bread!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)>I was talking about a different, sweet smell, like a
delicious apple!
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...<$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)><$voicel(2,7)>
Pode ser eu, não o pão!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu estava falando de um cheiro diferente, doce, como um
Uma maçã deliciosa!

dialogues.en:
Oh... <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>I think that might be meee you’re smelling...
<$emotion(1,65)><$voicel(1,3)>Awww... So there’s no yummy food around here?
dialogues.pt_br:
Oh... <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu acho que pode ser meee que você está cheirando...
<$emotion(1,65)><$voicel(1,3)>Awww... Então não há comida deliciosa por aqui?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,31)><$kfacial(2)><$voicel(2,3)>So it would seem. Rather disappointing, I must say.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,31)><$kfacial(2)><$voicel(2,3)>É o que parece, um pouco decepcionante, devo dizer.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Yeah... The yummy smell got me so huuungry.
<$facial(2,2)><$voicel(1,2)>Hey... <$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>Can I take a bite out of you? Just a liiittle one?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Sim... o cheiro delicioso deixou-me com tanta fome.
<$facial(2,2)><$voicel(1,2)>Hey... <$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,5)>Posso dar-te uma mordidela?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Absolutely not! Honestly, what a thing to ask!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Sinceramente, que coisa para se perguntar!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Awww... Nothing here either.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Awww... nada aqui também.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Somethin’ specific you’re lookin’ fer, <$cdef(27)><$cname(554)></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Algo específico que você está olhando’ fer, <$cdef(27)><$cname(554)></color>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>I was just looking for something to chew. Whenever
I don’t have something to gnaw on, I get kinda,
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>I dunno...antsy.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Estava à procura de algo para mastigar.
Eu não tenho algo para roer, eu fico tipo,
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Eu não sei...antsy.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... And one o’ the rocks lyin’ round here won’t do?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... E uma das rochas que aqui estão não serve?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,7)>Nah, rocks break too easily. I want something more
satisfying than a plain ol’ rock.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,7)>Não, as pedras partem-se muito facilmente.
Satisfação do que uma rocha simples.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I see, I see... Well, you’re in luck, ’cause I’ve got jus’ the
thing! <$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>This here shell o’ mine!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Ya won’t find anythin’ harder to chomp on—I can promise
you that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu vejo, eu vejo... Bem, você está com sorte, 'porque eu tenho jus’
Coisa! <$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Esta aqui concha o’ mina!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Você não vai encontrar nada’ mais difícil de mastigar em - eu posso prometer
Tu és assim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>No way! Are you sure? You can’t get mad at me if I end up
breaking it, OK?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>De jeito nenhum! Você tem certeza? Você não pode ficar com raiva de mim se eu acabar
A partir, está bem?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! I don’t mind one bit! I doubt you could break it
even if ya tried, so gimme all ya got!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>De qualquer forma, por que você se importa? Não tem nada a ver com você,

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,4)>I just wanna be more like <$cdef(27)><$cname(559)> already, but I’m leagues

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>Talk about pathetic.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Impressionado, porquê?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,4)>Eu só quero ser mais como <$cdef(27)><$cname(559)> já, mas eu sou ligas

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>Por falar em patético.

dialogues.en:

head high!

A lesão que você recebeu do treinamento é a prova de seus esforços!
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Se alguma coisa, é algo para se orgulhar!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>The movement. It is called dancing? I see. It is enjoyable.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,7)>Huh? It’s your first time, and you’re already THAT good?
Now THAT’S natural talent!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,7)>É a sua primeira vez, e você já é tão bom assim?
Isso é talento natural!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>You believe so? It is flattery.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>What other varieties of dance exist? You must teach
me more.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>Acreditas que sim?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Que outras variedades de dança existem?
Eu mais.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Ooh, you’re interested in learning? <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,8)>OK! There’s THIS type
of dance...<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,10)>and ones like THIS, too!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Ooh, você está interessado em aprender? <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,8)>OK! Há Este tipo
da dança...<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,10)>e uns como este, também!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,1)>I see. It appears difficult.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, nobody’s perfect right away. Just leave it to me—<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I’ll

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, ninguém é perfeito imediatamente. Deixe comigo...<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu vou
Mostra-te as cordas!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>I feel relief. I welcome your assistance.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Sinto-me aliviada, e saúdo a sua ajuda.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>C’mon, follow the rhythm better! One, two! One, two!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>Vamos, siga melhor o ritmo! Um, dois! Um, dois!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>One. Two. One. Two.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Um, dois, um, dois.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>No, no! You need more emotion in it! More FEELING!
All right, another try! One, two! One, two!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Não, não! Você precisa de mais emoção nele!
Um, dois, um, dois!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Ah. It is hard.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>É difícil.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>YEAH! Now you’re getting the hang of it! OK—let’s call it
here for today!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Sim! Agora você está pegando o jeito! OK - vamos chamá-lo
Aqui por hoje!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Ah. Ahhh. You are a strict teacher. It is surprising.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>That red, jewel-like object of yours is quite exquisite.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Thank you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Obrigado.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>At times, I’ve even seen it emit a peculiar light. It gives
you an air of mysticism.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Às vezes, eu já vi até mesmo emitir uma luz peculiar.
És um ar de misticismo.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Ah. It is a way I communicate with others.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>É uma forma de me comunicar com os outros.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh? But...I’m certain I’ve seen it glow when you
were alone.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh? Mas... tenho certeza de que já vi brilhar quando você
estavam sozinhos.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>I sometimes communicate with others who are far away.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Às vezes eu me comunico com outros que estão longe.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Is that so? How fascinating! Where are they located?
What sort of Pokémon are they?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>É isso mesmo? Quão fascinante! Onde eles estão localizados?
Que tipo de Pokémon são eles?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>I do not know.
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>But I sense them. They exist, I think. Somewhere far away.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,644)><$voicel(1,10)>They listen to what I have to say.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Não sei.
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas sinto-os, existem, acho eu, algures longe.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,644)><$voicel(1,10)>Eles ouvem o que eu tenho a dizer.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>How very poetic... And what sort of things do you discuss?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Quão poético... e que tipo de coisas discutem?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>My favorite foods. Et cetera.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>As minhas comidas favoritas.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Ah. How surprisingly...banal.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Que surpreendente... banal.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Hmm... That flashing pattern feels like...<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>“I’m hungry”?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>My, the ocean sure has felt rough lately.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh? It hasn’t seemed that way to me.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah? Não me pareceu assim.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re kidding!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Why, just a bit ago, I was nearly sucked into a whirlpool!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>I was just resting by a boulder when WHOOSH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Você está brincando!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>Há pouco tempo, quase fui sugado para um redemoinho!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Eu estava apenas descansando por uma pedra quando Whoosh!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmm? I’ve never found whirlpools to pose a problem.
In fact, mere minutes ago, as I was passing a boulder—
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>...Wait a moment.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>That whirlpool you nearly got caught up in... It’s possible
I caused it.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmm? Eu nunca encontrei redemoinhos para colocar um problema.
Na verdade, há poucos minutos atrás, quando estava a passar por uma pedra...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Espera um momento.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Aquele redemoinho que você quase ficou preso em... É possível
Eu causei-a.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Oh no! It was YOUR fault? Why in the world would you do
such a thing?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Não, a culpa foi tua, porque raio farias isso?
Uma coisa dessas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,7)>I merely let out a rather large yawn, the force of which
whipped up a comparably large whirlpool.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu apenas deixei sair um bocejo bastante grande, cuja força
Arrumou um redemoinho comparativamente grande.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Well, for goodness’ sake, be more careful!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>I mean, thankfully it was me that nearly got pulled
into the whirlpool...<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)> But what if it had been poor, sweet
<$cdef(27)>?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Bem, pelo amor de Deus, tenha mais cuidado!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Ainda bem que fui eu que quase fui puxado.
para o redemoinho...<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)> Mas e se tivesse sido pobre, doce
<$cdef(27)>?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Now, now, calm yourself, <$cdef(27)><$cname(558)>.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Not everyone is so easily perturbed by whirlpools. On the
contrary, <$cdef(27)><$cname(553)> often tells me how much they enjoy them.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Something about them being thrilling...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Agora, agora, acalme-se, <$cdef(27)><$cname(558)>.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Nem todos são tão facilmente perturbados por redemoinhos.
contrário, <$cdef(27)><$cname(553)> muitas vezes me diz o quanto eles gostam deles.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Algo sobre eles serem emocionantes...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)>But it’s terribly dangerous to get too close to a whirlpool!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>For crying out loud... From now on, <$cdef(27)><$cname(559)>, dear, you
need to take care NOT to create any!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)>Mas é terrivelmente perigoso chegar perto demais de um redemoinho!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Pelo amor de Deus, a partir de agora, <$cdef(27)><$cname(559)>, querida, tu
precisa ter cuidado para não criar nenhum!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, yeah! ’Cause <$cdef(27)> <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>made me

Um lar!
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>E além disso, eu não queria continuar incomodando você todos os

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>My goodness, you’ve really grown up, <$cdef(27)><$cname(591)>... <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>But you
know, sweetie, I never once thought you were a bother.
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>In fact, I’m a little lonely now.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Meu Deus, você realmente cresceu, <$cdef(27)><$cname(591)>... <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Mas tu...
Querida, nunca pensei que fosses um incómodo.
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Na verdade, estou um pouco só agora.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Really?
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>So is it OK if I keep sleeping beside you sometimes?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>A sério?
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>Então, posso continuar a dormir ao teu lado?

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Really?! ’Cause actually...
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>I’ve been missing you SO MUCH, <$cdef(27)><$cname(567)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I feel you. And that damp smell is hard to beat...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Oh, hey. We should play in mud together sometime.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>E esse cheiro húmido é difícil de vencer.

A minha electricidade...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Uh, nope? I didn’t feel a thing.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Não senti nada.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, phew.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>But, y’know...maybe we shouldn’t play in the mud together
after all. <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>What if I fired off electricity like that again?

<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, ufa.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas, você sabe... talvez não devêssemos brincar na lama juntos
Afinal de contas. <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>E se eu disparasse electricidade como aquela outra vez?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Uhhh... I mean, that kinda stuff doesn’t really bother me,

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Quero dizer, esse tipo de coisa não me incomoda,
Você sabe. <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Ainda podemos jogar juntos!
